title: DOI/BLM Land Use Parcel Record
description: Schema for Department of the Interior Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and federal land use parcel data including permits, designations, and environmental attributes

parcel_id.description: Unique UUID for this parcel record

blm_serial_number.description: BLM Land Serial Number (LSN) assigned to the parcel or case file

managing_agency.description: Federal agency with primary land management responsibility

state.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation where the parcel is located

county.description: County name where the parcel is located

land_type.description: Primary designated use classification for the parcel

total_acres.description: Total area of the parcel in acres

latitude.description: Centroid latitude of the parcel in decimal degrees

longitude.description: Centroid longitude of the parcel in decimal degrees

designation.description: Official designation name, e.g. National Monument, Wilderness Area, National Recreation Area

designation_date.description: Date the land was officially designated or classified

permit_type.description: Type of use authorization or permit associated with the parcel

permit_holder.description: Name of the individual, company, or entity holding the permit

annual_revenue.description: Annual revenue generated from permitted activities on this parcel in USD

environmental_assessment.description: True if a NEPA environmental assessment or EIS has been completed for this parcel

protected_species_present.description: True if federally listed threatened or endangered species have been identified on the parcel

fire_risk_level.description: Wildfire risk classification based on fuels, terrain, and weather patterns

last_inspection_date.description: Date of the most recent field inspection of the parcel

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the pipeline

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into the lakehouse

_source.description: Source system or API identifier for this record

_batch_id.description: Batch job identifier that produced this record
